package.name: rp1_swerve_controller
package.description: ros2_control controller_interface plugin for rp1's 4-corner swerve base: 4 drive velocity command interfaces + 4 steering position command interfaces, driven from a single geometry_msgs/TwistStamped cmd_vel, with real inverse kinematics and odometry (forward kinematics from wheel/steering state, published as nav_msgs/Odometry + an odom->base_link TF). See the README for what's implemented vs. still open (the 0/90-locked and 2-wheel operating modes from rp1-specs/requirements.md, the seek_home/home_* interfaces).
